description: This bar chart illustrates the ratio values for three large language models – Llama3, ChatGPT, and a third unnamed model – across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each category, there are three bars representing the ratio for each model; Llama3 is represented by blue bars, ChatGPT by red bars, and the third model by yellow bars. For the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 87%, the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 84%, and the third model’s bar reaches approximately 73%. In the “Songs” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 83%, the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 88%, and the third model’s bar reaches approximately 65%. Finally, in the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68%, the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 58%, and the third model’s bar reaches approximately 63%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
